integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled finite checker is a consistency test only and is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for convex cyclic polygons with no consecutive antipodal vertices and for interior points.
Absolute historical novelty is not certified; equivalent older formulations under polar-dual or discrete-Wirtinger language remain a residual bibliographic risk.
title: A path-eigenvalue proof of the cyclic–tangential Erdős–Mordell polygon conjecture
